description: Vite plugin that rewrites class:hover and className:focus into Tailwind CSS and UnoCSS utilities. No runtime.
rules: Prefer class:hover / className:focus modifier attributes over inline hover: / focus: / sm: / md: prefixes on class or className.
Put UseClassy before Tailwind or UnoCSS in the Vite plugins array so rewritten utilities are visible to the CSS engine.
Vue, Svelte, Blade, and HTML use class:modifier="…". React prefers className:modifier="…" (class:… is also accepted).
Do not rewrite Vue :class, native Svelte class:name={cond} directives, or arbitrary variants such as [&>*]:mt-2 or data-[state=open]:block into UseClassy attributes.
class:sm:hover="underline" emits sm:hover:underline only — the same composition as Tailwind/UnoCSS.
npx vite-plugin-useclassy init installs agent skills by default; pass --no-skills to skip.
